concerns.text: "System MUST implement a linear-time sieve to compute μ(n) for 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^7 and store the result as a binary array" contradicts the Key Entities definition of the Möbius Sequence as an array of integers {‑1, 0, 1}. A binary array can only hold two values.

All functional requirements reference "(See US‑1)" (or US‑2, US‑3) but no User Story identifiers US‑1, US‑2, US‑3 are defined anywhere in the document; the user stories are labeled "User Story 1" etc. This cross‑reference is undefined.

FR‑003 mandates generating 1,000 random sign permutations preserving zero proportion, while the Assumptions section describes a block‑permutation scheme of size b = 100 that preserves intra‑block order. These two descriptions are mutually exclusive and create a contradictory implementation requirement.
